name: John Titor
title: He Said He Came from 2036 to Steal a 1975 Computer
claims: TimeTravel_0 first posted on the Time Travel Institute forum on November 2, 2000 | 1
The forum was established in 1998 for discussing time travel and fringe science | 1
The first post was in an existing thread titled "Time Travel Paradoxes" | 1
The poster said time travel basics start at CERN and end in 2034 with a time machine built by GE | 1
The name "John Titor" was not used until January 2001 | 1
Opening message quoted: "I am a time traveller from the year 2036... IBM 5100 computer system from the year 1975" | 2
Machine described as a "stationary mass, temporal displacement unit" with two top-spin dual-positive singularities and a "standard off-set Tipler sinusoid" | 1, 2
First post listed components: magnetic housings, electron injection manifold, cooling/X-ray venting, gravity sensors, four cesium clocks, three computer units | 1
Machine was installed in a 1967 Chevrolet Corvette convertible for 1975, then a 1987 four-wheel-drive truck for 2000 | 1
Titor posted pictures, including a laser pointer supposedly bending in the field; another account says user's manual pictures | 2
The trip plan: drive truck to Tampa, go back, drive to Minnesota, change vehicle, machine about 500 lbs, 1975, Tampa, 2036; heat and 1.5 to 2 G; need rebreather or oxygen | 2
Titor said he was from central Florida, stationed at an Army base in Tampa | 2
Titor's unit retrieved items from the past to help society recover | 2
Civil war to begin 2004 around presidential election; "Waco type event every month"; full war by 2008; five regions (Feb 1, 2001 post) | 1
War ends 2015 with brief nuclear WWIII called "N Day"; Washington D.C. and Jacksonville hit; Omaha new capital | 1
One account says the exchange killed nearly three million | 2
Causes only described as "border clashes and overpopulation" | 1
Titor warned about Creutzfeldt–Jakob disease from beef | 1
Advice: learn basic sanitation, learn to shoot and clean a gun, consider what to bring if leaving home in ten minutes | 2
"My goal is not to be believed"; said people of this era seen as lazy, self-centered, civically ignorant sheep | 2
First fax to Art Bell dated July 29, 1998; Bell hosted Coast to Coast AM | 1
Fax described time travel invented 2034, CERN byproduct, "contained singularity engine," Y2K disaster, collapse of US government, barrier at 2564 | 1
Second fax promised operations manual pages and photographs and said Russia would "eventually save this country" | 1
October 14, 2000 IRC chat: TimeTravel_0 claimed to be 38, from Florida, at MacDill Air Force Base, sent to 1975 for an IBM 5110, mentioned four times | 1
From November 2, 2000 he said IBM 5100 instead, without acknowledgement | 1
IBM 5100 released 1975; 5110 successor released 1978 | 1
He sent a correspondent a piece of an IBM 5110 label with an Orlando postmark | 1
Titor said 5100 was needed to debug legacy systems in 2036, possibly a reference to the Unix 2038 problem | 1
5100 could emulate IBM System/370 mainframes and translate machine code; undocumented | 1
An engineer who helped design it confirmed the feature; IBM kept quiet over competitors | 2
Some observers concluded the author had insider knowledge, e.g. a computer scientist | 1
Titor said he was chosen because his paternal grandfather helped assemble and program the 5100 | 1
Final Titor post was in late March 2001 | 1
Around 2003 websites compiled posts into narratives, not always keeping original dates | 1
John Titor Foundation published book John Titor: A Time Traveler's Tale in 2003 | 1
No civil war in 2004; Olympics not cancelled; no collapse of Western stability; mad cow not rampant; same president in 2005 | 2
No 2015 nuclear war (implied by sources' dates) | 1, 2
Titor invoked many-worlds interpretation; his travel created a new timeline, making predictions non-falsifiable | 1
Titor put divergence at 1 or 2 percent and said it would grow over time; cited football games and news timing | 2
Some fans argue the posts might have averted the war | 2
2008 Italian TV program Voyager aired investigation (May 19, 2008); private investigator found no record of John Titor | 1
John Titor Foundation: for-profit company formed September 16, 2003, rented mailbox in Kissimmee, Florida; Titor-linked IP geolocated to Kissimmee | 1
2009 Hoax Hunter report pointed to the foundation's CEO, a Florida entertainment lawyer, and a computer-expert brother | 1, 2
The investigator concluded the family very likely behind Titor, with the name first introduced in 1998 with different predictions including Y2K | 1, 2
Accounts differ on which brother | 1, 2
The people named have denied it; no one has publicly claimed authorship | 1
John Titor trademark registered, now "Abandoned" | 1
In 2018 the creator of the alternate reality game Ong's Hat said he consulted for the unnamed people behind the legend, calling it a "literary experiment" and saying "it wasn't my project" | 1
Original forum threads remain the primary record | 1
Steins;Gate (2009 visual novel) features the Titor legend and IBM 5100 mission; docudrama Timetravel_0 in 2009 | 1

sources.title: Who was John Titor, the 'time traveller' who came from 2036 to warn us of a nuclear war? - Telegraph
